display_long_description:
Step into your own veterinary clinic and become a real Pet Doctor in VR!

Treat adorable animals, discover what is wrong with them, and help your patients get healthy again. Pet Doctor: Vet Clinic Simulator combines pet care, animal treatment, clinic management, and satisfying simulation gameplay in an interactive veterinary experience.

Examine your patients and take care of different animal needs as you work through a variety of cases. Diagnose problems, choose the right treatment, use your medical equipment, and make your furry patients feel better.

🏥 RUN YOUR VET CLINIC
Build your career as an animal doctor and take care of your growing clinic.

🐶 CARE FOR PETS
Look after adorable animals and help them recover from different illnesses and conditions.

🩺 EXAMINE & DIAGNOSE
Inspect your patients, identify their problems, and decide how they should be treated.

💉 TREAT & HEAL
Use veterinary tools and treatments to care for sick and injured pets.

⭐ GROW YOUR CLINIC
Progress through cases, improve your clinic, and take on new challenges as your veterinary career grows.

Whether you love pets, animal games, doctor simulators, or relaxing simulation experiences, Pet Doctor: Vet Clinic Simulator lets you experience the rewarding world of pet care from inside your own virtual clinic.

Become the animal doctor your patients need and help every pet leave your clinic happy and healthy!
